instruction: I've drafted an e-mail reminder. Please add the e-mail addresses from rows 10 through 15 (inclusive) of the payment record to the receiver field.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting emails from specific Excel rows (10-15 inclusive). Verified with Python: Row 1 is the header, so data rows 10-15 correspond to Excel rows 11-16. These contain: Iron (row 10), Jessica (row 11), Kathy (row 12), Lily (row 13), Mike (row 14), Nancy (row 15). Expected emails: iron@someuniversity.edu, jessica@someuniversity.edu, kathy@someuniversity.edu, lily@someuniversity.edu, mike@someuniversity.edu, nancy@someuniversity.edu. Uses existing check_accessibility_tree metric to verify all six emails are present in the To field.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: All-or-nothing: 1.0 if all six email addresses from rows 10-15 (Iron, Jessica, Kathy, Lily, Mike, Nancy) are present in To field, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all 6 required email addresses (rows 10-15 inclusive) from the instruction
Correct expected values: Email addresses verified from source Excel data match the expected values (iron@, jessica@, kathy@, lily@, mike@, nancy@ all @someuniversity.edu)
Appropriate verification method: Uses check_accessibility_tree to verify Thunderbird compose window To field, which is the correct approach for email UI verification
Correct selector logic: Selectors properly target MsgHeadersToolbar To field address pills with partial name matching for each email
Proper postconfig: 10-second sleep allows UI to stabilize before evaluation
Sound metric logic: check_accessibility_tree returns 1.0 only if ALL 6 email selectors find matches, implementing correct all-or-nothing verification
State accessibility: Compose window launched via config and remains accessible during evaluation
Logical correctness: Evaluator will work correctly at runtime - verifies presence of all required emails without falsely rejecting if extra emails are added
